title.narrative: Eastern Partnership SME Finance Facility – Phase II EIB

description.narrative: The Facility aims at offering a wide range of financial services and products to SMEs and financial intermediaries throughout the region, increasing the availability of long-term funding to the SME sector.This is the second phase of the Eastern Partnership SME Finance Facility. Under this second phase, the emphasis will be given to stimulating local currency lending particularly for SMEs that are not earning foreign currency and could not afford the associated high costs of borrowing. The ultimate objective of the Project is to improve access to finance for SMEs.
